compiled_state.description:
## Context
During documentation-epic closeout, Gerrit REST reported changes 2809, 2810, 2812, 2817, and 2821 as status MERGED on branch main. Their reported current revisions are respectively 85abd2fbfbdff, af20ccffd83e9, a80e0bc4c4c9, 290c33322bab, and 42a589d33d39.

Both live refs currently resolve to d99198e64414e7dc2607b8dbe7acdacbb3cf944f:
- gerrit refs/heads/main
- origin refs/heads/main

Every reported merged revision above fails git merge-base --is-ancestor against that head, and current main contains none of their Change-Id trailers. Later changes 2855-2858 are reachable normally, so this is a bounded historical interval rather than a general query mistake.

## Impact
A Gerrit change can appear safely merged while its patch is absent from main. Ticket closeout and automation that trust status=MERGED can falsely claim work landed. The affected comment-remediation leaves must be re-landed as fresh corrections instead of being closed against these orphaned revisions.

## Investigation scope
A separate debug session should determine whether this came from an authorized main-history rewrite, Gerrit submit/rebase behavior, replication, or ref corruption; enumerate the full affected interval; and establish the durable invariant between MERGED status and branch reachability. Do not debug or fix this inside rubbery-glacial-cowbird.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Reproduce the mismatch from live Gerrit REST and refs.
- [ ] Identify the proven root cause and the full affected change set.
- [ ] Restore or explicitly reconcile every affected patch.
- [ ] Add a deterministic guard or operational check that detects MERGED revisions not reachable from their destination branch.
- [ ] Record recovery and prevention evidence on this bug.
compiled_state.title: Gerrit MERGED changes 2809–2821 are unreachable from current main
